explainer_content.short_definition: The core 1960s UK beat-group road where British bands reframe American roots music as self-contained pop-rock.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Beatlemania opened the U.S. door, but the lane includes multiple UK answers: Beatles melodic craft, Stones blues bite, Who mod force, Animals R&B drama, Yardbirds guitar escalation, and Hollies/Searchers harmony. Together they turned the band into the main pop-rock unit.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It shifted attention from solo idols toward groups that wrote, played, recorded, and visually branded themselves. Much later rock band mythology starts here.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is guitar-band direct but highly varied: Merseybeat handclaps, blues covers, rave-up solos, harmony hooks, and mod volume can all belong if the UK beat-group engine is clear.
what_to_listen_for: Band identity as part of the song
